title: Gluten Free Food

official_sources.title: Food Products Standards & Food Additives Compendium — current chapter index
FSSAI Guidance Note — Gluten Free Foods
FoSCoS Guidance Document V1.1 — Gluten Free Foods are not standalone product listings

overlay_model.foscos_instruction: Select the corresponding underlying food category/product and additionally comply with the Gluten Free Food standard.
engine_sequence: Resolve the underlying food identity and product standard
Check whether the formulation fits the Chapter 2.14 ingredient framework
Require analytical gluten result for any gluten-free labelling conclusion
Check gluten result against the below-20 mg/kg requirement
Apply current FSSAI Labelling and Display and Advertising and Claims requirements in addition

operative_rules.rule: Gluten free food consists of or is made of one or more ingredients containing rice, millets, ragi, pulses or legumes.

The chapter carries a historical cross-reference to the former Packaging and Labelling Regulations. PMSV preserves the chapter text for traceability but maps live labels to the current FSSAI labelling framework before issuing a label conclusion.

operative_rules.topic: Foods naturally suitable for a gluten-free diet
operative_rules.rule: A food naturally suitable for a gluten-free diet shall not be named special dietary, special dietetic or equivalent. It may state that the food is by its nature gluten free only when the essential composition requirement is met and the statement is not misleading.
For labelling a product as gluten free, analysed gluten shall be below 20 mg/kg using the method basis stated in the regulation.

runtime_policy.final_compliance_lock: Do not issue a final gluten-free compliance/label conclusion without an underlying food profile, an analytical gluten result below 20 mg/kg and current label-rule validation.

regulatory_notes: FoSCoS guidance treats Gluten Free Food as an additional standard applied to the corresponding underlying food category, not as a standalone product selection.
The below-20 mg/kg gluten threshold is a strict less-than condition, not less-than-or-equal-to.
Chapter 2.15 is separate and has been omitted from the current regulations; PMSV does not use the former 20–100 mg/kg route.
